[[File:Special_Forces.jpg|thumb|right|245px|Special forces troopers]]
'''Special forces''' were any military [[unit]] trained specifically to undertake particularly difficult missions that could not be expected of regular [[soldier]]s, and their missions were generally of a more confidential nature. Similar to [[Commando/Legends|Commandos]].
